maria: quick heads-up — found a rollback safety hole in the scope editor when we revert role changes during canary rollouts.

aditya: ugh. details?

maria: if an admin uses the console "dry-run" then toggles back to live and hits rollback, we patch the same role bindings but we don't include the route-quota override flag in the payload. result: routing service treats those routes as unscoped and triggers fallbacks.

sam: repro steps?

maria: 1) create role with scope X + quota override
2) canary it to 5% with dry-run on (UI shows preview only)
3) flip canary off and click rollback
4) watch routing logs: `missing_scope=true` events for that tenant

kevin: so the console patch omits `quota_override: true` when dry-run -> live transition? that's an API bug not UI.

aditya: confirmed — console uses `PATCH /internal/role-bindings/:id` with body coming from local state. the dry-run state wasn't merged back. quick fix is to always include explicit `quota_override` field even if false.

sam: are we sure adding explicit false won't break older authz service versions?

aditya: authz tolerates unknown fields; but older service expects the header `X-Route-Quota` for overrides. backend change needed to treat missing field as preserved.

rbac-bot: incident-note: possible customer impact if rollback occurs during canary — routes may route to cheaper fallback models. tag: customer-visible-quota-mismatch

maria: proprosal: 1) console patch to always send explicit flags for scope/quota during patch/rollback; 2) add a telemetry event `perm_rollback_preview_applied` with sampling=1% and include `route_count` and `quota_override` boolean; 3) add a short UI banner in rollback modal "This rollback will also revert route quotas; if you used dry-run we will preserve explicit flags — click to review".

kevin: +1 on telemetry event. we should also log `effective_permissions_diff` as a compact hash in the event so SRE can correlate with routing fallbacks without leaking PII.

aditya: implementation note: I'll change frontend to attach `explicit_flags` map and include `X-Perm-Digest` header computed from current state. backend will normalize missing keys to prior values unless header says replace.

sam: timeline?

aditya: I'll put a small PR today for the client change, backend normalization needs a quick patch (1 day). telemetry + UI copy can follow in the same sprint.

maria: sounds good. follow-ups: @kevin can you add a tiny console e2e for rollback with dry-run to catch regressions? @sam can you add a quick alert query in dashboards to flag `missing_scope=true` spikes after a rollback?

kevin: yep, will add e2e test in `console-integration` and mark as flaky until fixed.

sam: adding grafana alert draft now: query looks for `router.events{missing_scope="true",env="$env"}` grouped by tenant for 5m > 5 occurrences.

maria: thanks. I'll update the rollout checklist doc and add the rollback safety checklist item. :thumbsup:

aditya: PR link when ready and I'll coordinate canary for backend.

rbac-bot: note saved to /incidents/perm-rollback-safety-check — auto-tagged.
